title: Defy the elements with Le Col
content:
Cyclist
Defy the elements with Le Col

Winter: time to hibernate and hit the indoor trainer, right? Wrong. With the right kit for the job, Le Col’s autumn/winter 2026 range will have you relishing every ride in the great outdoors between now and the clocks going forward again in the spring.

Le Col has spent the past 15 years developing and refining the very best performance riding kit for all manner of cycling tribes, whether you’re a certified roadie or gravel rider. And, with the brand’s pro cycling experience informing everything it creates – not to mention boasting a community of almost one million cyclists – Le Col makes the strongest case for being the one-stop shop for all your performance gear needs.

This year’s seasonal collection is a shining example of the depth and breadth of the British-born company’s offering. Here are the highlights…

Need for speed

Le Col’s Pro Collection represents the pinnacle of its pursuit of performance gains. Every piece is designed with maximum speed and efficiency in mind, employing wind-tunnel tech and feedback from professional cycling teams to set new standards in race-ready apparel. This range is for anyone who wants the edge, even if you just want to bring the pain on a rapid training ride with mates!

New for 2026 is the aero-optimised Pro Jacket (RRP £275, now £165), a windproof and showerproof jacket with incredible breathability, thanks to Polartec Power Shield fabric – built for fast, high-tempo winter rides.

The Pro Aero Long Sleeve Jersey (RRP £210) is Le Col’s fastest jersey. It combines aerodynamic performance with a precision fit, so you get the most from your efforts. An advanced fabric on the inside reduces aerodynamic drag, while the jersey also boasts enhanced moisture wicking fabric to keep you comfortable when you’re pushing hard.

• Check out the Le Col Pro Collection here: men | women

In it for the long-haul

The timeless Hors Categorie Collection is designed for the rider who wants to go the distance, with no compromise made on luxurious fabrics, refined details and exemplary comfort.

The new Hors Categorie Long Sleeve Jersey (RRP £200, now £140) stands out for its comfort, light weight, insulation and fast-wicking construction. It’s knitted from a four-way stretch fabric with brushed inner, and is designed to shrug off cold weather.

Like the entire Hors Categorie range, this jersey has a premium look and feel, with top-quality sleeve grippers, comfortable neck taping, a large, zipped waterproof rear pocket (as well as the standard three other pockets) and reflective details for winter safety. In brief, it’s the ideal blend of performance and comfort for massive days in the saddle.

• Check out the Le Col Hors Categorie Collection here: men | women

Everyday heroes

The Le Col Sport Collection offers arguably the best of both worlds. Balancing performance and value, this range is aimed squarely at the rider who just wants to ride – but, whether a social spin or daily commute, to ride in comfort.

The Sport Long Sleeve Block Jersey (RRP £125, now £95 men’s/£75 women’s) is ideal for autumnal coffee rides, being lightweight, breathable and featuring a waterproof pocket for peace of mind (after all, nobody wants a waterlogged wallet).

The lightweight, windproof and packable Sport Gilet (RRP £95, now £55) will keep you warm on early mornings (or descents), and when not in use will stuff straight into a jersey pocket.

And, to keep your leg muscles warm, look no further than the Sport Cargo Bib Tights II (RRP £200, now £140). They combine soft-brushed thermal fabric, stretch-comfort, storage pockets on the legs, and a triple-layer, gel-insert chamois for optimum shock-absorbing comfort – whether it’s a century ride or a simple Sunday bimble.

• Check out the Le Col Sport Collection here: men | women

True grit

Le Col hasn’t forgotten those of us who love a bit of dirt, with the ARC Gravel Collection providing stacks of kit to help you perform at your best off the beaten track. This collection has been tested and developed with pro gravel racers, and, in Le Col’s own words, is ‘engineered with purpose’. Performance fabrics mix with premium Italian merino wool, the apparel is bristling with storage, and – most importantly – it’s designed with durability at the forefront.

The ARC Lightweight Rain Jacket (RRP £295, now £120) is the standout piece for winter adventures. Using Pertex Shield technology with fully taped seams and a waterproof two-way zip, it offers full waterproofing, yet weighs just 190g and packs down small. The hood fits over a helmet, the durable ripstop fabric is built to last (there’s even a repair patch included), and the relaxed fit makes it just as at home off the bike as on it.

• Check out the Le Col ARC Gravel Collection here: men | women
